result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Your blood test (HbA1c) was done on 16 September 2026. The result was 58 mmol/mol.
You will keep taking your medicine (metformin) at the same dose for now. The dose has not been increased yet.
The dose increase will be talked about at your review.

## What you need to do
1. Keep taking metformin 500 milligrams twice a day for now.

## Dates and medicines
- 16 September 2026: HbA1c blood test. Result: 58 mmol/mol.
- 9 November 2026: review appointment. Raising your metformin dose will be talked about then.
- Metformin: 500 milligrams, twice a day. Continue for now.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What does my HbA1c result of 58 mmol/mol mean for me?
- What will we talk about when we discuss a higher dose at my review?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.
